使用前，了解这几件事。: A few things to know before you begin.
桌面工具在本机处理输入与文件，不需要云端账户。官网仅展示产品和读取 GitHub: Desktop tools process inputs and files locally without a cloud account. This website presents the product and reads GitHub release information. It does not upload your files.
切换语言会丢失输入吗？: Will switching languages clear my input?
不会。界面语言即时切换，工具内容保留。桌面与官网各自记住语言选择；用户输入和转换: No. Interface text switches immediately while tool content is preserved. The desktop app and website remember their language choices independently. Your inputs and converted documents are not automatically translated.
所有 PDF 都能准确转换吗？: Can every PDF be converted accurately?
扫描版 PDF、复杂排版、字体及表格可能影响结果，当前不提供 OCR；转换后请检: Scanned PDFs, complex layouts, fonts and tables can affect conversion. OCR is not included. Check the converted content. Legacy .doc files are not supported.
保存正在处理的内容并关闭旧版，下载对应平台的新版本后安装或替换。当前没有自动更新: Save your work and close the old app, then download and install or replace it with the version for your platform. There are no automatic updates. New unsigned versions may trigger system warnings again.

文件写入保护、Markdown 预览净化、任务状态一致性和本地文件访问范围检查。: Protected file writes, sanitized Markdown previews, consistent task state and local file access checks.
